notes: «زرت عائشة مع عبيد بن عمير فسألها» puts Ubayd in the scene as the asker (rule 6); Aisha is the one asked who answers, so she is the last link.
The RWY claim that lists Ubayd as a link is not followed (see the fix).

fixes.reason: RWY ends its route with عبيد بن عمير, but the text makes him the asker in the scene; the relayed answer is Aisha's.
